	Who gets to eat it?
strings.translation:
在路边发现了一个迷你装糖果棒!
	谁来吃它?

strings.original: does a sweet parkour move involving just kind of walking through the zombies' legs. Whatever!
strings.translation: 做了某种很酷的跑酷动作, 穿过了尸潮. 没人知道是怎么做到的, 但管它呢!

strings.original: off some garbage and over the fence. No big deal. It's all too trivial a move for
strings.translation: 翻过垃圾、越过围栏. 这对

strings.original: awkwardly tries to scale the fence but is way too out of shape to do so. The zombies attack.
strings.translation: 笨拙地试图爬上围栏, 但动作太不规范了. 僵尸发起了攻击.

strings.original: manages to climb up the fence in time, avoiding being ripped apart for now. God bless parkouring.
strings.translation: 设法及时爬上围栏, 暂时避免了被撕裂. 上帝保佑跑酷人.

strings.original: understands the concept of throwing things, but really isn't that good at it due to not having thumbs.
strings.translation: 知道什么是　扔东西　. 但由于没有拇指, 它真的扔不太准.

strings.original: bowls several zombies over by throwing garbage cans.
strings.translation: 扔出几个垃圾桶, 砸翻了一些僵尸. 于是

strings.original: escapes and gets a great workout at the same time.
strings.translation: 成功的逃离了. 同时这也是一次很好的锻炼.

strings.original: tries to fight the zombies off by throwing garbage cans at them, but doesn't manage to throw enough to stop their attack.
strings.translation: 试图通过向僵尸扔垃圾桶来击退他们, 但扔的力量不足以击倒它们.

strings.original: COMPLETELY flips out and starts flinging stuff at zombies followed by stomping on them. It's both effective and very therapeutic for
strings.translation: 完全失控了，开始向僵尸扔东西，然后暴怒着踩碎僵尸。这对
来说是一种很棒的发泄.

strings.original: makes mistakes while scouting a town, and gets cornered by a large group of zombies while unarmed.
strings.translation: 在侦察城镇时犯了错误, 在手无寸铁的情况下被一大群僵尸逼入绝境.

strings.original: is trapped in an alley. At the end of the alley is heavy garbage and a large fence.
strings.translation: 被困在一条小巷里. 小巷的尽头是沉重的垃圾和一道大栅栏.

strings.original: Run whenever you can! Fight when you're forced to. These zombies do not drop zombie loot.
strings.translation: 能润就润! 最好尽快完成你的搜刮. 毕竟僵尸又不会爆金币.

strings.original: Scavenge for all the ammo you can. Build up the skills of your team. You'll need to become stronger!
strings.translation: 尽你所能地搜刮弹药. 提升小队成员的属性. 你需要变得更强!

strings.original: Swinging melee weapons around is exhausting until you increase your strength and fitness!
strings.translation: 挥舞近战武器非常消耗体力, 所以尽可能提高你的力量和体能吧!

strings.original: When exhausted, you start to sweat. Stop swinging for awhile or you'll do much less damage.
strings.translation: 当你精疲力尽时, 你会开始出汗. 停下来休息一会儿, 否则你的攻击伤害将大大降低.

strings.original: You can keep your car going way longer if you have a great mechanic in the team.
strings.translation: 如果有一位出色的机械师在小队中, 就可以让你的车开得更久.

strings.original: If you don't like your Always Be Looting choices, try driving around for new locations.
strings.translation: 如果不喜欢事件　搜刮不停歇　的选项, 你可以试着开车去别的地方.

strings.original: More people means more fighters! It also means more food consumption.
strings.translation: 更多的人意味着更多的战斗力! 但这也意味着更多的食物消耗.

strings.original: Someone with maxed Medical skill needs less medical supplies for healing, or sometimes none.
strings.translation: 医术高超的人能用更少的医疗用品来治疗伤口. 有时甚至不用医疗用品.

strings.original: Higher Shooting skill means better firearms handling, with each shot piercing more zombies!
strings.translation: 更高的射击属性意味着更快的瞄准, 和更好的后坐力控制. 同时每一枪都能穿透更多的僵尸!

strings.original: Strength lets you pick up and throw heavier furniture. Thrown furniture is the best weapon.
strings.translation: 力量值越高, 你就能举起并投掷更重的家具. 投掷家具是最好的攻击方式.

strings.original: A combination of Strength and Fitness determines weapon swing speed and energy use.
strings.translation: 力量和体能会共同影响　武器挥动的速度　和　体力消耗的快慢　.

strings.original: Make sure you create some custom characters! They can show up at random in the game.
strings.translation: 一定要创建一些自定义角色! 他们可能会在游戏中随机出现哦.

strings.original: For the final stage of the trip, you will need a good group or great weapons.
strings.translation: 在旅行的最后阶段, 你将需要一个足够强力的小队, 或者一些强大的武器.

strings.original: Fitness reduces melee weapon cooldown. You get a significant bonus to stamina regen at 6 fitness!
strings.translation: 体能决定了你有多少近战体力, 以及体力恢复的速度.

strings.original: TIRED gives big stat penalties! Clear it by sleeping in the next camp or resting before a mission.
strings.translation: 疲惫将会导致严重的属性下降! 好好利用下一次扎营, 或在任务准备时让那人　留在车上　来休息.

strings.original: If team member morale gets too low, they will start arguing, despairing, and backstabbing.
strings.translation: 如果小队成员的士气太低, 他们可能会排斥彼此、降低属性甚至拔刀相向.

strings.original: Throw furniture by picking it up then pressing attack. Throwing can be powerful and efficient.
strings.translation: 投掷家具的方式: 先捡起来, 然后按攻击键投掷出去. 这种战斗方式既强力又高效.

strings.original: Characters can have personality traits that give them more options in events!
strings.translation: 角色会拥有不同的特质. 有些能让你在事件中获得额外的选项!

strings.original: Paranoid characters can reduce the severity of bandit attacks, or reveal the stats of new recruits.
strings.translation: 偏执的角色可以降低强盗攻击的严重程度, 或者看出新成员的部分属性.

strings.original: Oblivious characters can safely run out of morale. A couple times.
strings.translation: 具有　健忘　特质的角色在前几次耗尽士气时可以保持安全.

strings.original: Charming characters get all sorts of bonuses, particularly in Trader Camps.
strings.translation: 具有　魅力爆棚　特质的角色能得到各种各样的额外惊喜, 尤其是在商人营地.

strings.original: Irritating characters always know the worst thing to say. They have a SECRET ADVANTAGE.
strings.translation: 烦人的角色总是知道怎样说出最难听的话. 但他们有一个　秘密优势　.

strings.original: Bandit characters can rob many traders and other people. This can backfire depending on who is robbed.
strings.translation: 强盗角色可以抢劫很多商人或其他人. 当心被反杀 ----- 如果你打劫的目标不好惹.

strings.original: Slow, heavy weapons can be powerful with high Strength and Fitness. Otherwise they can be awful.
strings.translation: 一些笨重的武器在你拥有　高额力量和体能　后才能发挥出最大威力, 否则会难以使用.

strings.original: Some melee weapons break and some don't! Many common breakable weapons compensate by being light.
strings.translation: 有些近战武器会损坏, 有些则不会! 但许多常见的易损武器会通过　轻便易用　来弥补这一点.

strings.original: Zombies have to grab onto you for a short time before they can damage you. Run away to break free!
strings.translation: 僵尸必须抓住你一小段时间, 然后才会造成伤害. 逃跑, 挣脱束缚!

strings.original: Losing your car opens you up to nearly constant negative events and bandit attacks.
strings.translation: 失去车会让你面临几乎持续不断的负面事件和强盗袭击.

strings.original: Many traders offer you different things depending on how much food you have.
strings.translation: 大部分商人会根据你的食物数量来为你提供不同的商品.

strings.original: If you have little or no food, some traders will pity you and give free stuff!
strings.translation: 如果你的食物很少或者干脆没有, 一些商人会怜悯你, 然后免费送你东西!

strings.original: Dogs are very fast. For fun, try having a dog solo loot a city as everyone rests!
strings.translation: 狗的速度很快. 为了好玩, 你可以试着让其他所有人都休息, 只操控一只狗来搜刮一整个城市!

strings.original: Dog barking, horns, gunshots, and other noises draw zombie attention.
strings.translation: 狗叫声、喇叭声、枪声和其他噪音都会引起僵尸的注意.

strings.original: Zombies can chase you for a long time, depending on how aggressive and irritated they get.
strings.translation: 僵尸或许会追你很长一段时间, 这取决于它们的攻击性和愤怒程度.

strings.original: Some places are death traps! Read the zombie forecast before exploring an area.
strings.translation: 有些地方简直就是死亡陷阱! 在探索一个区域之前, 请仔细阅读　僵尸预报　.

strings.original: Fire and explosives can damage your own characters, so watch out. Fire is especially dangerous.
strings.translation: 近战和子弹不会对友方造成伤害, 但是爆炸和火焰会! 不要玩火自焚了!

strings.original: Fire can clear out an army of zombies if you're lucky. It's very dangerous to use indoors.
strings.translation: 如果你使用得当, 火焰可以很好地清除僵尸大军. 但在狭小的区域使用它非常危险.

strings.original: Punching a zombie with no weapon barely does anything, besides making one let you go for a moment.
strings.translation: 虽然赤手空拳揍僵尸的效果甚微, 但至少可以让你暂时摆脱它的纠缠.

strings.original: You can switch what character you are controlling in the pause menu, for finer control.
strings.translation: 如果你想对全局有更好的把控, 可以在暂停菜单中切换角色或装备. 双击装备栏可以让AI队友只使用那个装备.

strings.original: Characters that are close by can throw weapons to each other in the pause menu.
strings.translation: 距离较近的角色可以在暂停菜单中交换武器.

strings.original: Try sacrificing someone you don't like by getting them eaten on purpose. This will distract zombies.
strings.translation: 试着牺牲你不喜欢的人, 故意让他们被吃掉. 这会分散僵尸的注意力.

strings.original: Character stats are initially hidden. Characters you recruit may be lying about their abilities!
strings.translation: 角色属性最初是不可见的. 你招募的新成员可能在撒谎!

strings.original: Many bandits can be bought off with food. Some bandits can be beaten by a specific personality type.
strings.translation: 许多强盗可以交出食物应付. 有些强盗还可以被特定的性格类型打败.

strings.original: If your characters all have full health, fighting off bandits will usually not kill any of them.
strings.translation: 如果你的角色都是满血的, 和强盗们打一架通常不会直接杀死任何人.

strings.original: All stats go from 0 to 6. A stat of 0-1 will usually automatically fail. 5-6 will usually succeed.
strings.translation: 所有属性最低为0, 标准上限为6. 0 - 1 的属性通常会直接导致判定失败.  5 - 6 则通常会让你判定成功.

strings.original: Closing doors will hold off zombies for awhile, as they all forgot how to open doors.
strings.translation: 关上门能拦住僵尸一会儿, 因为他们都忘记了如何开门.

strings.original: Zombies attack furniture that gets in the way. You can drop or throw objects to make obstacles.
strings.translation: 僵尸只会直线接近你, 并试图破坏沿路的家具. 你可以移动家具来制造障碍.

strings.original: Some cars types are easier to repair than others, requiring a smaller Mechanical skill.
strings.translation: 有些车型比其他车型更容易维修, 对机械属性的要求更低.

strings.original: A very high Mechanical skill will let you repair a car right away. Further repairs become harder.
strings.translation: 只要机械属性足够高, 你就可以直接修好车辆. 但随着修理次数的增加, 后续的修理会变得越来越困难.

strings.original: Slow-shooting firearms are very ammo efficient. Sometimes you'll want to spray ammo with an automatic.
strings.translation: 低射速的枪械很省弹药. 但有时你也需要用自动武器扫射.

strings.original: Some melee weapons cleave, hitting multiple zombies in one swing. Some cleaves are based on chance.
strings.translation: 一些近战武器可以进行大范围劈砍, 一次攻击就能同时伤害多个僵尸. 而有些劈砍的攻击数量则是随机的.

strings.original: Zombies get more aggressive and numerous at night. Zombies smell you better if you're bleeding.
strings.translation: 僵尸在夜间会变得更加凶猛且数量增多. 如果你在流血, 僵尸会更容易嗅到你的气味.

strings.original: Zombies get hit for extra damage if they are knocked down, first. Some weapons have high knockdown.
strings.translation: 僵尸被击倒后会受到额外伤害. 有些武器很容易击倒僵尸.

strings.original: Some great melee weapons for high stat people: Knight's Sword. Sturdy Machete. Fire Axe. Sledgehammer.
strings.translation: 一些对于高属性角色来说很棒的近战武器: 骑士剑. 坚固砍刀. 消防斧. 大锤.

strings.original: Some great melee weapons for low Strength/Fitness: Aluminum Bat. Nightstick. Xtreme Hockey Stick.
strings.translation: 一些适合低力量/体能的近战武器: 铝合金球棒、警棍、极限冰球棒.

strings.original: Shotguns are still very effective for people with low Shooting skill. High damage and knockdown.
strings.translation: 霰弹枪对于射击属性低的人也很好用. 具有很高的伤害, 并且很容易击倒僵尸.

strings.original: The pistols and the Uzi have the advantage of bullets being the most common ammo type.
strings.translation: 手枪和乌兹冲锋枪的优势在于它们使用的子弹是最常见的弹药类型.

strings.original: Automatic weapons are very hard to control if you have low Shooting skill.
strings.translation: 如果你的射击属性很低, 自动武器将会很难控制.

strings.original: Rifles have high damage and high piercing. One shot could splat an entire line of zombies.
strings.translation: 步枪具有高额伤害和超强穿透力. 一枪就可能把一整串僵尸轰飞.

strings.original: You can often have teammates rest in the car. Useful if someone's hurt or you want a smaller group.
strings.translation: 在你出发搜刮前, 你可以选择哪些队友在车里休息. 如果有人受伤、疲惫或你只是不想带太多人去, 这会很有用.

strings.original: There's no real penalty for getting a teammate eaten by zombies. Just throwing that fact out there.
strings.translation: 让队友被僵尸吃掉并没有其它的惩罚. 最好还是赶紧离开.

strings.original:
- Figure out your favorite traits and perks, then make a bunch of custom characters with them.
	- If you have spare gas, you can skip many locations. Each skip makes good ones more likely!
	- For endgame, you want high stats and either great melee weapons or an automatic + ammo.
	We've run out of hints! Good luck!
strings.translation:
- 找出你最喜欢的天赋和特性，然后用它们制作大量自定义角色.
	- 如果有多余的汽油，你可以跳过许多地点。每跳过一个地点，就更有可能找到更好的地点!
	- 对于游戏决战, 你可能需要很高的战斗属性，强大的近战武器或自动武器以及弹药.
	已经没有什么其他提示了!祝你好运!

strings.original: TESTING CITY OF LOST HOPE IN DEADLIER ROAD MODE!
strings.translation: 尝试　超死亡之路　模式来探索这些失去希望的城市!
成败得失, 在此一举!

strings.original:
Test this and post a comment if there are:
	1. Missing buildings: There should be 4 lootable

strings.translation:
测试一下, 如果有以下情况, 请反馈:
	1.有建筑物丢失: 应该有4个厕所
	2.建筑物的门不在地图里

strings.original:
This option will take you straight to Canada, the final mission on the final day!
	The purpose of this is to help people with the crash bug.
strings.translation:
此选项将带你直接前往加拿大, 在最后一天执行最后一次任务!
	这样做的目的是帮助人们解决崩溃错误.

strings.original: Get ready... for a superior JoJo experience.
strings.translation: 准备好......踏上一次卓越的JoJo冒险.

strings.original: Get ready... for a Mechnical shopping experience.
strings.translation: 准备好......得到一次机械化购物体验.

strings.original: Get ready... for a relaxing park experience.
strings.translation: 准备好......享受一次放松的公园体验.

strings.original:
hears rumors that Canada is a safe place, free of the threat of zombies.
	With nothing to gain from waiting around Florida,
strings.translation:
听说加拿大是世界上最后的净土, 在那里没有僵尸的威胁.
	由于在佛罗里达州只能坐以待毙,

strings.original: decides to brave the Death Road and travel north.
strings.translation: 决定踏上死亡之路北上.
所有钥匙都找到了! 恭喜!

strings.translation: 加拿大死亡之路8/26测试版

Welcome to the Death Road to Canada Alpha!

	You can find a full list of recent changes and instructions to help us test the game by clicking the NEWS link on the Death Road to Canada Steam page.

strings.translation:
欢迎来到加拿大死亡之路测试版!
	当前测试: 特殊字符

	通过Kickstarter消息向我们发送反馈!

strings.original: is now part of the team!

quietly groans a little bit about this.
	Onward to Canada!
strings.translation:
无声地呻吟着.
	前往加拿大!
将油门踩到了底, 从那里润了.

strings.original: It seems like a good start.
strings.translation: 这似乎是一个好的开始.

strings.original: starts the journey to Canada, they meet their neighbor,
strings.translation: 开始了前往加拿大的旅程, 他们遇到了邻居,

strings.original: has always hated this person, but could use the help and/or decoy.
strings.translation: 以前一直很讨厌这个人, 但现在可以好好利用一下.

strings.original: named this shotgun BIG DAWG. It is capable of exploding zombies, both near and far. For a novice, it's possibly the best choice of firearm.
strings.translation: 把这把霰弹枪命名为　敖犬霰弹枪　. 无论多远, 这把枪的威力都足以炸开僵尸. 对于新手来说, 这可能是最好的枪支选择.

strings.original: Rifles are capable of puncturing through multiple zombie heads, in the hands of a great shooter!
strings.translation: 一个老练的射手能仅用一把步枪就射爆多个僵尸的头!

strings.original: isn't necessarily a great shot, but practice makes perfect.
strings.translation: 不一定能打出这样的一枪, 但多练练就能做到.

strings.original: The humble pistol may not have the power of bigger firearms, but it gets the job done. That, and pistol bullets are still rather plentiful. Open any drawer and some will likely spill out!
strings.translation: 简陋的手枪没有像重型枪械一样的威力, 但它也能很好的尽到肃清僵尸的责任. 而且, 手枪子弹很容易找到. 打开任何一个抽屉, 都可能会发现手枪子弹!

strings.original:
Weapons: who needs them? The car is a weapon. The further that huge chunk of metal can be driven before it runs out of gas, the safer the journey is.
	Also, maybe you'll run into a chainsaw.
strings.translation:
武器: 谁需要它们? 汽车是一种武器. 在汽油耗尽之前, 这大块金属行驶得越远, 旅途就越安全.
	此外, 也许你会碰到链锯.

strings.original: takes a small detour to a stash of supplies that
strings.translation: 绕了一小段路来到了一个隐藏的物资库, 那是

strings.original:
left there before. 
 Besides a dinky bit of food and medicine, the stash had:
strings.translation:
早就藏好的.
 除了少量的食物和药品外, 这些藏匿物还包括:

strings.original: is now part of the team!

winces as the new recruit scarfs down the two long-hoarded food cans.
	Onward to Canada!
strings.translation:
在新成员狼吞虎咽地吃下两个过期的罐头食物时, 吓了一跳.
	继续前往加拿大!
将油门踩到了底, 飞速的离开了.

strings.original: NO ONE TOUCHES MY CANS OF FOOD.
It was probably the right choice.
runs into someone just wandering the road, sledgehammer over shoulder.
strings.translation: 遇上了一个扛着大锤在路上徘徊的人.

strings.original: self, and offers to join the mission to Canada in exchange for some food to chow down on.
strings.translation: 他自己, 然后主动提出加入小队一起前往加拿大, 以换取一些食物.

strings.original: decides to visit their grizzled mentor one last time before heading north.
strings.translation: 决定在北上之前最后一次拜访他们的退休导师.

strings.original: and offers some final advice before the journey starts:
strings.translation: , 并在旅程开始前提供了一些最后的建议:
永远不要相信任何人或任何事

strings.original: IF SOMETHIN BREAKS JUST HIT IT
strings.translation: 如果有什么东西坏了就砸它

strings.original: The Death Road to Canada 5/27 Alpha
strings.translation: 加拿大死亡之路5/27测试版

strings.original:
hears rumors that Canada is a safe place, free of the threat of zombies.
	With nothing to gain from waiting around Florida,
strings.translation:
听说加拿大是世界上最后的净土, 在那里没有僵尸的威胁.
	在佛罗里达州干等没有什么用,

strings.original: is tired of being a gravekeeper. Everyone just keeps crawling out of the ground right after they're buried.
strings.translation: 厌倦了当守墓人. 每次埋了人, 他们就又从地里爬出来了.

strings.original: keeps blasting dark music about vampires and such.
strings.translation: 不断播放吸血鬼风格的黑暗音乐.

strings.original: We're All Out of Death Road
strings.translation: 我们都走出了死亡之路

strings.original: The Mountie's clothing is pristine, despite his zombie slaugtherings.
strings.translation: 骑警的衣服很原始，尽管他有僵尸般的杀戮.

strings.original: The Mountie is merely winded. Somehow not even his clothes are ripped from his battle with the zombies.
strings.translation: 这个骑警只是喘了口气. 不知怎么的, 他的衣服在和僵尸的战斗中竟然没有被撕破.

strings.original:
WELL, THIS IS ALL WE GOT FOR NOW, EH?
	CONGRATULATIONS ON WINNING THE ALPHA!
strings.translation:
好吧, 这就是我们现在的全部, 嗯?
	祝贺你通关测试版!

strings.original: Please post your feedback so far to Kickstarter, either by direct message or by using the comments section for the last private update.
strings.translation: 到目前为止, 请通过直接消息或使用最后一次私人更新的评论部分将你的反馈发布到Kickstarter.

strings.original: spots a fork in the road leading to a dark tunnel full of wrecked cars. The sounds of undead echo from the entrance.
strings.translation: 发现一个岔路口通向一条黑暗的隧道, 隧道里挤满了失事的汽车. 僵尸的声音在入口处回响.

strings.original: sees a bunch of destroyed cars on a dirt road in the distance, surrounded by zombies. It may be worth the risk to walk there and see if there's any loot left.
strings.translation: 看到远处一条土路上有一群被毁的汽车, 周围都是僵尸. 冒险去那里看看是否还有赃物, 也许是值得的.

strings.original: is travelling down a gravel road when
strings.translation: 在一条碎石路上行驶时

strings.original: see a group of wrecked cars ahead, with an undead horde travelling through it.
strings.translation: 看到前方有一群被撞毁的汽车, 一群僵尸正从中穿行.

strings.original: is driving down the highway in a quiet countryside. Up ahead is a big crowd of burnt out cars, with zombies roaming around them.
strings.translation: 在一个安静的乡村里沿着高速公路行驶. 前方是一大群被烧毁的汽车, 僵尸在它们周围游荡.

strings.original: is driving through a city when
an intersecting road congested with rusted cars and a horde of already angry zombies.
strings.translation: 一个十字路口, 那里挤满了一大群愤怒的僵尸和一大片锈迹斑斑的汽车.

strings.original: The End of the Death Road

has made it to right before the border to Canada!
	So close to safety, here's where it gets the most dangerous!
strings.translation:
终于快要抵达加拿大边境了!
	但在黎明前也最是黑暗!

strings.original: spots an abandoned Y'all-Mart off in the distance. It looks like it's been looted, but maybe there's some untouched loot inside.
strings.translation: 在远处发现了一个被遗弃的丫尔玛. 它看起来像是已经被洗劫过了, 但或许里面还有一些未被发现的物资.

strings.original: finds a grocery store. Zombies wander inside, as if guarding the remaining food.
strings.translation: 找到一家便利店. 僵尸在里面游荡, 好像在守护剩下的食物.

strings.original: finds a hardware store. There may be cans of gas or a chainsaw here, but only if other people haven't picked the place clean yet.
strings.translation: 找到一家五金店. 这里很可能会有几罐汽油或一把链锯, 但前提是其他人还没有把这个地方掠夺一空.

strings.original: spots a big grocery store. Many zombies roam inside, guarding shelves and storage rooms.
strings.translation: 发现一家大型超市. 许多僵尸在里面游荡, 把货架和储藏室当成了它们的地盘.

strings.original: watches as another survivor retreats into a big grocery store. The survivor is pursued by a large, angry horde.
strings.translation: 目睹了一名幸存者被一大群愤怒的僵尸逼进一家大型超市里.

strings.original: sees a big Y'all-Mart. A large amount of undead protects the supplies scattered around inside.
strings.translation: 看到了一个超大的　丫尔玛超市　. 大量的僵尸保护着散落在里面的物资.

strings.original: sees a large bookstore. Most of the books and magazines have gotten wet and rotted by now, but one here remains in good condition.
strings.translation: 看到一家大书店. 到目前为止, 大多数书籍和杂志都已经湿透腐烂了, 但这里有一本仍然完好无损.

strings.original: spots a large sporting goods store. Many zombies roam inside, likely fallen looters once hunting for a gun or machete.
strings.translation: 发现一家大型体育用品商店. 许多僵尸在里面游荡, 很可能是曾在这里寻找装备的倒霉掠夺者.

strings.original: spots a big grocery store. Even its parking lot is packed with zombies. Not too many scavengers have been able to get near all the food still inside.
strings.translation: 发现一家大型超市. 就连停车场也挤满了僵尸. 看起来没有多少幸存者能拿到里面的食物.

strings.original: spots a large Yall-Mart packed with zombies. Ignoring the heavy danger, it could be a great shopping experience.
strings.translation: 发现了一个挤满了僵尸的大型丫尔玛超市. 若不是有巨大的风险, 这本会是一次很棒的购物体验.

strings.original:
The outbreak in this crowded grocery store happened so fast that the panicked crowd turned into zombies before the place could be looted.
	Many of the groceries are still on the shelves.
strings.translation:
在这家拥挤的超大型超市中, 僵尸感染感染得十分的快, 恐慌的人群很快就变成了尸潮——在里面的食物被抢走之前. 
	许多食品仍还留在货架上.

strings.original: I hope you got an OP character!
strings.translation: 我希望你有遇到过强力角色!

strings.original: Zombies were no match for your group!
strings.translation: 僵尸在你的小队面前什么也不是!

strings.original: Congrats! Now try Four Jerks EXTREME!
strings.translation: 恭喜! 现在来试试极限4混蛋模式吧!
极限4混蛋模式通关 恭喜!

strings.original: Congrats! Now try the ULTRA-HARD modes!
strings.translation: 恭喜！现在来试试最难的模式吧!

strings.original: BUT... WHAT BECAME OF THEM IN CANADA?
strings.translation: 但是... 他们在加拿大又发生了什么呢?

strings.original: BUT... WHAT BECAME OF HER IN CANADA?
strings.translation: 但是... 她在加拿大又发生了什么呢?

strings.original: BUT... WHAT BECAME OF HIM IN CANADA?
strings.translation: 但是... 他在加拿大又发生了什么呢?
Rocketcat Games　和　Madgarden　倾力巨献
所以... 这就是加拿大 嗯

strings.original: There are no penguins in Canada...

strings.translation: 但是你看... 冰啊, 雪啊... 企鹅啊!

strings.original: I met a bunch of weirdos!
I saw a lot of familiar faces!
strings.translation: 我看到了许多熟悉的面孔!

strings.original: And I met so many interesting people on the way!
strings.translation: 我在路上遇到了许多有趣的人!

strings.original: Good thing I had all my friends!

strings.translation: 我完成了... K*E*P*A 模式!

strings.original: That was a pretty big detour!
You made it, but there's an even longer road mode!
strings.translation: 你做到了，但还有更长时间的游戏模式!

strings.original: Lots of interesting people on the Death Road!
strings.translation: 死亡之路上有很多有趣的人!

strings.original: WHAT WAS SO RARE ABOUT THESE CHARACTERS?
WOW! WHAT A BUNCH OF JERKS!
You are a true Death Road-er!
strings.translation: 你是真正的死亡之路玩家!
但是... 你真的获胜了嘛?
你是不是在哪里把Kepa弄丢了?

strings.original: I hope the trip didn't take too long for you!
strings.translation: 我希望这次旅行对你来说不会太长!

strings.original: You took the scenic route, eh?
strings.translation: 你选择了风景最优美的路线，嗯?

strings.original: This was supposed to be Endless!

strings.translation: 哇! 这可真是太超模了!

strings.original: Can't believe we're still getting tourists!
strings.translation: 真不敢相信还有人能来我们这旅游!

strings.original: Canada is going to be great!
This was definitely worth all the carnage!
strings.translation: 所有的杀戮绝对都是值得的!

strings.original: I'm sorry that the journey is over now!
strings.translation: 很可惜, 我们的旅程到站了!

strings.original: I already hate Canada! Canada smells bad!
strings.translation: 我现在讨厌加拿大了! 这里的气味真的令我难以忍受!

strings.original: I can't believe I marched all the way here!
strings.translation: 我真不敢相信我一路走到了这里!
我现在真的是　嗨　到　不　行　啊! !
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊! 我做到了!

strings.original: My prediction was a 90% chance of reaching Canada!
strings.translation: 我的预测是有90%的机会到达加拿大!

strings.original: I learned a lot about myself. And zombies.
strings.translation: 我对自己的了解更深刻了. 也包括对僵尸的.

strings.original: I bet I could get here even easier, knowing what I do now.
strings.translation: 我敢打赌, 要是我早知道现在的情况, 我可以更容易地到达这里.
呼? 噢, 我成功了.

strings.original: Where am I? I wasn't paying attention.
strings.translation: 我现在在哪? 我刚才没注意.

strings.original: This is all thanks to teamwork!

strings.translation: 让我们做永远的朋友吧!

strings.original: Friendship is the reason we made it!
strings.translation: 友谊是我们成功的原因!
不! 只剩下我一个人了!

strings.original: Here's to the ones that didn't make it.
strings.translation: 为那些没能挺过来的人敬一杯.

strings.original: Well uh... crap. Guess I'm alone.
strings.translation: 嗯......该死. 我想只剩我一个了.

strings.original: Err woops. Well, who needs friends I guess.
strings.translation: 呃啊......唉. 行吧, 谁会需要朋友啊.

strings.original: Nice, a whole new country to rob.
strings.translation: 好啊, 又有一个全新的国家可以去抢劫了.

strings.original: I knew that I'd make it hhhhheh.
strings.translation: 我就知道我会成功的, 口也!
让我来统治这个地方吧!

strings.original: Look at all these suckers. I'll do fine here.
strings.translation: 看看这些傻瓜. 我在这里会过得很好.

strings.original: I punched a moose so hard that it exploded!
strings.translation: 我狠狠地打了一只驼鹿, 然后它被我打爆了!
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊! 啊啊啊啊!
近战不出狂战斧, 不如回家卖红薯 ! ! !

strings.original: Time to enjoy the Canadian way of life!
strings.translation: 是时候享受加拿大的生活方式了!

strings.original: That's enough zombies for me, thanks.
strings.translation: 那么多僵尸真是够了, 谢谢.

strings.original: Wait! I left my toothbrush in Florida!
strings.translation: 等一下! 我把牙刷忘在佛罗里达了!

strings.original: That was a lot of zombies.
I'm going to need a new car...
I feel insecure with no throwing chairs in sight.
strings.translation: 我感到很不安, 因为这没有椅子能扔.

strings.original: I hope I can loot more toilets later.
strings.translation: 我希望以后能多搜刮下厕所.

strings.original: Time to kick back and relax.

strings.translation: 我真的得好好休个假了.

strings.original: This is all thanks to me!
This is just like in my Japanese animes!
strings.translation: 这一切梦幻得就像我看过的日本动漫一样!

strings.original: They made fun of my anime figurines but who's laughing NOW?
strings.translation: 他们曾经取笑我的动漫手办, 但现在是谁笑到最后了?

strings.original: This is all thanks to the superiority of Japanese weaponry!
strings.translation: 这都多亏了日本的躬匠精神!

strings.original: Well, I didn't explode this time so that's nice.
strings.translation: 好吧, 我这次没有爆炸, 所以这很好.

strings.original: I'm still on alert. I'm assessing threats.
strings.translation: 我随时都会保持警惕. 我现在正在评估威胁.

strings.original: I'm faster than Sonic the Hedgehog!
strings.translation: 我比刺猬索尼克还要快!

strings.original: I've satisfied my hunger... for victory!
strings.translation: 我已经满足了我的饥渴......对胜利的饥渴!

strings.original: I was getting tired of eating canned food.
Are you gunna eat that? Cause I will.
strings.translation: 你要吃那个吗? 我也想吃.

strings.original: Feh! I can't believe I was convinced to leave my cabin.
strings.translation: 切! 真不敢相信我竟然被说服离开了我的小屋.
厚!厚!厚!厚!厚!厚!厚!厚!厚!厚!

strings.original: All that training came in handy!
strings.translation: 所有的培训都派上了用场!

strings.original: That was a good battle. I guess.
strings.translation: 我觉得,这真是一场精彩的战斗。

strings.original: That made me think of a new wrestling move! The MECHA PRESS!
strings.translation: 这让我想到了一个新的摔跤动作!

strings.original: One-two... one-two... I'm brutal and ruthless!

strings.translation: 知识再次胜利!我将统治一切!.

strings.original: I'm going to need some stylish winter clothes...
strings.translation: 我需要一些时髦的冬装...

strings.original: That was easy! Rollerderby's more dangerous.
strings.translation: 这太简单了! 加勒比海比这危险多了.

strings.original: I never believed I'd make it!
Hhhhheh I'll be running this place in a week, tops.
strings.translation: 呵呵呵,最多一个礼拜我就能统治这里.

strings.original: HA! TIME FOR A NEW ADVENTURE!
strings.translation: 哈! 是时候开始新的冒险了!
Ooo! 不要忘记我呀! Oooooo!
我们可真是... 干净利落!

strings.original: I'm a mercenary.... a mercenary for hire.
strings.translation: 我是雇佣兵.... 雇佣兵.

strings.original: Half-Life 3 is NOT coming out, sorry.
strings.translation: 半条命3永远不会面世，抱歉.
阿布拉卡布达, 麻瓜!

strings.original: INTERFERE WITH THE WITCH'S FUN, GET SHOT BY THE WITCH'S GUN!
strings.translation: 谁挡着女巫，谁就被女巫射成蜂窝!

strings.original: I owe it all to the skeletons!
strings.translation: 我把一切成功都归功于骷髅!

strings.original: I hear Toronto has a thriving LARPing scene!
strings.translation: 我听说多伦多的相扑事业很兴盛!

strings.original: Wow! A new place to burn down.
strings.translation: 哇一个可以烧毁的新地方.

strings.original: I'm still stuck in this costume! Help!
strings.translation: 我还被困在皮套里！帮帮我!

strings.original: Perfect! I can terrorize way more humans here!
strings.translation: 太完美了! 我可以在这里吓更多的人!

strings.original: It's way too cold here for this outfit!
strings.translation: 这里太冷了，不适合穿这身衣服!
美国#1! 喔哦! 喔哦哦哦哦哦哦!
美国主义的又一次100%胜利!

strings.original: My log says this is a good place to stay.
strings.translation: 我的航海日志说这是个住宿的好地方.

strings.original: Good Grief! TRANSLATOR'S NOTE: THIS LOOSELY MEANS 'YARE YARE DAZE'
strings.translation: 悲痛欲绝! 译者注：意为 牙累牙累打贼

strings.original: I have a confession to make... I was actually a broom the entire time.
strings.translation: 我得坦白...我其实一直都是一把扫帚.

strings.original: Heh... all thanks to Sweet Lady Propane.
strings.translation: 嘿......这一切都要归功于煤气罐皇后.

strings.original: Now that I'm here, it's time to check up on my friends... and some women.
strings.translation: 既然已经到了，就该去找找我的朋友们......或者一些女人了.

strings.original: It's so exciting to be in the unknown!
strings.translation: 在未知的世界里是多么令人兴奋啊!
哇偶. 加拿大. 真酷, 我觉得挺酷的.

strings.original: Oh hey, I made it. Thanks fer playing Death Road to Canada!
strings.translation: 哦嘿，我成功了。感谢您玩 加拿大死亡之路 !

strings.original: The Phoenix rises! ==flaps arms like they are wings==
strings.translation: 凤凰涅槃! ==做着铁山靠动作==

strings.original: became a stand up citizen of Canada.*
strings.translation: 成为了加拿大的合法公民.*

strings.original: got kicked out of Canada after refusing to give up guns.*
strings.translation: 因拒绝缴枪而被驱逐出加拿大*

strings.original: channeled EHIS gun obsession into a productive hobby: pine cone collecting.*
strings.translation: 将EHIS对枪支的痴迷转化为另一种建设性的爱好: 收集松果*

strings.original: became a famous trick-shooting attraction at the Canadian Circus.*
strings.translation: 成为了加拿大马戏团著名的特技射击表演者*

strings.original: accidentally shot EHIS own foot off, within 5 minutes of entering Canada.*
strings.translation: 在进入加拿大不到五分钟, 就不小心射中了EHE自己的脚. *

strings.original: shot a penguin by accident, violating the Canadian Prime Directive.*
strings.translation: 意外的射杀了一只企鹅. 这违背了加拿大总理的指示. *

strings.original: gets arrested after finding EHIS medical practice is not licensed in Canada.*
strings.translation: 因在加拿大因没有行医资格证被捕*

strings.original: diagnoses every single one of EHIS patients with a farting problem.*
strings.translation: 深入诊断EHIS每一个有肛肠科问题的患者*

strings.original: tries to cure the zombie infection, but just makes their hair a little nicer.*
strings.translation: 想要逆转僵尸感染, 但实际上只是让它们的发型变得好看了一点*

strings.original: develops a cure for flatulence, which is then named after EHIM .*
strings.translation: 开发了一种治疗肠胃胀气的药物, 随后以EHIM自己的名字命名*

strings.original: does a mad doctor head transplant with a moose. This becomes very popular!*
strings.translation: 用驼鹿头做了一次疯狂的换头手术. 这引领了新的潮流! *

strings.original: makes incredible innovations to the Mecha Mounties. They now serve coffee.*
strings.translation: 对机械骑警进行了鬼才改造. 他们现在可以煮咖啡了*

strings.original: designs a very popular line of goofy three wheeled cars.*
strings.translation: 设计了一堆非常好玩的三轮碰碰车*

strings.original: is recognized as a hero after inventing a more overpowered chainsaw.*
strings.translation: 在发明了一种更强大的链锯后被公认为大佬*

strings.original: invents a new version of the chainsaw, one with colorful lights attached to it.*
strings.translation: 发明了一种挂彩灯的新型光污染链锯*

strings.original: becomes rich after inventing a car engine that runs off poutine.*
strings.translation: 在发明了一种肉酱驱动的发动机后大赚了一笔*

strings.original: invents a better mousetrap. It has carbon fiber on it and a USB drive.*
strings.translation: 发明了一个能插U盘的碳纤维捕鼠器*

strings.original: came up with a wildly popular fitness program based on EHIS zombie survival experience.*
strings.translation: 根据EHIS僵尸生存体验开了一个末日培训班*

strings.original: became an athlete in the post-zombocalypse Olympics, where Canada won every medal!*
strings.translation: 成为僵尸末日后的奥运会运动员, 其中加拿大赢得了所有奖牌! *

strings.original: lived a long, healthy life in Canada. At the age of 100, was bit by a moose and exploded.*
strings.translation: 在加拿大健康长寿的生活着. 在他100大寿的时候被一只驼鹿咬了一口, 然后炸了*

strings.original: took up hockey, excelling at it after all that practice knocking zombie teeth around.*
strings.translation: 开始打曲棍球, 专门打飞僵尸大牙那种*

strings.original: invented a new zombie-specific martial art, then taught it to many disciples.*
strings.translation: 发明了一种新的防尸武术, 然后授予诸多桃李*

strings.original: devoted EHIS entire life to helping restore bodybuilding to its former glory.*
strings.translation: EHIS将毕生致力于让健美再次伟大*

strings.original: started flexing continuously after crossing the border, and never stopped. No one minded.*
strings.translation: 在越过边境后开始不断地显摆肌肉, 也不打算要停下. 但没人介意. *

strings.original: became a legendary folk hero after suplexing a moose that EHE was arguing with.*
strings.translation: 打败了一头与EHE争斗的驼鹿, 因此被写入了民间神话故事, 成为了一名传奇英雄. *

strings.original: would often return to the border, just to throw heavy furniture at more zombies.*
strings.translation: 会经常回到边境, 只是为了继续向僵尸扔家具爽爽. *

strings.translation: 请不要把它们用在这里.

strings.original: drops a lot of food into the window. Someone pushes an uzi back out! It can spray out bullets at an incredible speed! Watch out, even a skilled shooter will have trouble with the recoil.
strings.translation: 往窗户里扔了很多食物. 有人把乌兹冲锋枪从里面扔了出来! 它能以惊人的速度喷出子弹! 小心使用它, 因为即使是一个熟练的射手也很难应对它的后座力.

strings.original: Have fun! Also please go away.
strings.translation: 玩得高兴! 但不要在这儿玩.

strings.original: feeds a very large amount of food into the window. There's a pause, then someone pushes an assault rifle through! This could really help the trip!
strings.translation: 把大量的食物喂进窗户. 停顿了一下, 然后有人推出了一把突击步枪! 这真的可以给这次旅行提供很大帮助!

strings.original: Thanks for all the food! Good luck out there!
strings.translation: 谢谢你提供的食物! 祝你好运!

strings.original: feeds a very large amount of food into the window. There's a pause, then someone beyond the door starts pushing a dozen grenades back through.
strings.translation: 把大量的食物倒进窗户. 里面停顿了一下, 然后有人开始把十几枚手榴弹倒了回来.

strings.original: feeds a massive amount of food into the window. Someone on the other side of the door strains to push a flamethrower through the little window.
strings.translation: 把大量的食物塞进窗户. 在门的另一边有人把火焰喷射器用力地从窗户里推出来.

strings.original: slowly feeds a car-load of food into the window. Scraping noises are heard and then a minigun barrel is pushed through from the darkness. The frame of the window is broken due to the size of the minigun as it's jammed through.
strings.translation: 慢慢地把一车的食物送进窗户里. 随后听到一阵叮叮咣咣, 只见一挺加特林机枪从黑暗中被推了出来. 窗户的框架都被那机枪的巨大尺寸给挤坏了.

strings.original: Thanks so much! I can hide in here for months now!
strings.translation: 非常感谢! 我现在可以在再多躲几个月了!

strings.original: finds an army surplus store, covered in barricades. It's locked tight. There's a sign of weapon prices on a wall outside, next to a small window.
strings.translation: 发现了一个被改造成陆军基地的大号垃圾箱. 盖子锁得很紧. 在它的侧面潦草地画着武器名称和价格, 武器图案边开了一扇小窗户.

strings.original: Just drop the food in the window!
strings.translation: 想买东西就把食物扔到窗户里!

strings.original: says a tiny voice in the darkness.
strings.translation: 黑暗中一个微弱的声音说道.

strings.original: There isn't enough food to buy anything that they are selling!
strings.translation: 没有足够的食物来买他们卖的任何东西!

strings.original: farts right in front of the shotgun guy.
strings.translation: 在那个拿霰弹枪的家伙面前放了个响屁.
你先别急, 吆喝这么大声再把尸群引来了.

strings.original: This causes him some sort of emotional crisis.
strings.translation: 这给他带来了某种情绪危机.

strings.original: You're right! What am I even doing with my life?!
strings.translation: 你说得对! 我用我的生命在做什么? !

strings.original: The peddler is really annoyed by this.
I'm trying to make a living here!
. It's a one of a kind custom shotgun! Every shot is a massive blast of zombie splattering.
strings.translation: . 这是一把独一无二的定制霰弹枪枪! 每一枪发出的巨大冲击波都能让僵尸四散飞溅.

strings.original: buys a rifled slug shotgun. It fires a heavy, solid slug instead of buckshot. A skilled shooter could destroy a solid line of zombies with each shot!
strings.translation: 买了一把独头霰弹枪. 它发射的是重型实心弹头, 而不是铅弹. 熟练的射手每一枪都能摧毁一片僵尸!

strings.original: buys an automatic shotgun. This weapon fires way faster than a normal shotgun, though the power of a single shot is a little weaker.
strings.translation: 买了一把连发霰弹枪. 这种武器的射击速度比普通霰弹枪快得多, 尽管单发的威力稍弱.

strings.original: buys a shotgun. The peddler throws in some shells for free!
strings.translation: 买了一把霰弹枪. 商人免费赠送了些弹药!

strings.original:
stops for awhile at a small settlement. No one is trusting of outsiders, everyone seems very cold and silent.
	Only one voice can be heard booming out:
strings.translation:
在一个小定居点停了一会儿. 没有人信任外人, 每个人似乎都很冷漠和沉默. 
	只能听到一个声音:

strings.original: SHOTGUNS FOR SALE! SHOTGUNS FOR SAAAALE!
strings.translation: 出售霰弹枪! 打折的霰弹枪!

strings.original: There isn't enough food to buy anything! Out of pity, the peddler gives
strings.translation: 没有足够的食物买任何东西! 小贩出于怜悯而给予
一些免费的霰弹枪子弹.

strings.original: takes a look at the collection and then rolls
strings.translation: 看了看收藏品, 然后转了下
你先别急, 收藏这么多枪, 是急着干啥呀.

strings.original: Yeah, I think my collection is getting too big. Mind just taking some off my hands?
strings.translation: 是的, 我觉得我的收藏品太多了. 介意帮我减轻一些负担吗?

strings.original: a scoped hunting rifle and an
strings.translation: 一把带瞄准镜的狩猎步枪和一把

strings.translation: 步枪收藏家似乎受到了打击.
赶紧滚开, 不然就开枪了.

strings.original: . The collector seems glad to sell it.
strings.translation: . 收藏家似乎很乐意把它卖掉.

strings.original: Well, technically it's not a rifle! And I couldn't figure out how to hang it on my wall, so...
strings.translation: 从技术上讲, 这不是步枪! 我没法把它挂在墙上, 所以......

strings.original: buys a high powered hunting rifle. The collector gives you a great price on it, as she already has several.
strings.translation: 买了一把狩猎步枪. 收藏家给了你一个很好的价格, 因为她已经有好几把了.

strings.original: The great thing about hunting rifles is that one shot can splat a lot of zombies. My record is 7 in one shot!
strings.translation: 狩猎步枪的最大优点就是一枪就能打死很多僵尸. 我的记录是一枪打死 7 个!

strings.original: buys an assault rifle. Nearly as powerful as a cowboy rifle per shot, and it fires much faster.
strings.translation: 买了一把突击步枪. 每发子弹的威力几乎和牛仔步枪一样大, 而且发射速度也快得多.

strings.original: I prefer the single shot rifles, personally. Automatics use up too much ammo and don't pierce as well.
strings.translation: 就我个人而言, 我更喜欢单发步枪. 自动武器消耗弹药太快了, 也没法一发打穿多个僵尸.

strings.original: buys a cowboy rifle. The collector throws in some ammo for free, along with a second rifle!
strings.translation: 买了一把牛仔步枪. 收藏家免费送给你了一些弹药, 还送出了第二把步枪!

strings.original: Cowboy rifles are great for beginners. Easy to handle, fun to shoot. I find tons of these, so take two!
strings.translation: 牛仔步枪非常适合初学者. 操作简单, 射击有趣. 我发现了很多这样的枪, 所以这第二把枪你就拿走吧! !

strings.original:
stops for awhile at an apartment building. It has been turned into a small fort by a peaceful group of survivors.
	One invites you to check out her collection of rifles.
strings.translation:
在一栋公寓楼停了一会儿. 它被一群友善的幸存者变成了一座小堡垒. 
	有人邀请你查看她的步枪收藏.

strings.original: I've gotten so many that I'm looking to sell one!
strings.translation: 我得到了这么多, 我想卖掉一个!

strings.original: There isn't enough food to buy any! To be friendly, the collector gives
strings.translation: 你的食物不够买任何东西! 出于友善, 收藏家送给
告诉这个火急火燎的女人
不知怎么回事, 她对别急好像挺高兴的.
哇! 	噢哇哇哇哇哇哇!

strings.original: nearly her entire stock. 8 molotovs, a parking meter, and a
strings.translation: 她几乎所有东西. 8燃烧瓶、一根停车计价表, 和一把

strings.original: The weapons trader is infuriated by this.
COOL IT? COOL IT??! LOSERS COOL IT!!
strings.translation: 别急 ? 你敢让我别急 ??! 废物才慢悠悠的 !!

strings.original: realizes that this was a pretty bad idea! The trader signals the rest of her group to attack!
strings.translation: 意识到这是个非常糟糕的主意! 军火商示意她小队的其他成员发起攻击!

strings.original: buys a couple of molotov cocktails.
A little fire can go a long way!
When in doubt, burn it all down!!
Don't use them all in one place!
strings.translation: 不要把它们一起丢在一个地方!

strings.original: buys a parking meter? It's very heavy.
strings.translation: 购买了一根停车计价表? 它还挺重.

strings.original: We ripped this out of the ground! That's how we can pass the savings on to you!
strings.translation: 这是我们从地上扯下来的! 这就是我们省停车费的方法, 现在传给你!

strings.original: buys a chainsaw! It converts spare gas into zombie destruction.
strings.translation: 购买了一把链锯! 它可以将汽油转化为撕碎僵尸的动力.

strings.original: Hahaha! PERFECT! Rip them all apart!
strings.translation: 哈哈哈! 完美! 把它们统统撕碎!

strings.original: buys a flamethrower! Try not to shoot your team members with it.
strings.translation: 购买了火焰喷射器! 你可别用这个把自己烧了.
哇哦! 看起来和你很搭! !

strings.original:
stumbles into the camp of a large group of intimidating people. They're dressed somewhere between biker gang and 80's post apocalypse movie.
	One particularly intense looking woman offers to sell you a spare weapon.
strings.translation:
跌跌撞撞地闯进了一个里边都是满脸横肉壮汉的营地. 他们的打扮介于飙车党和 80 年代末世电影那样. 
	一个长相特别迷人的女士向你兜售备用武器.

strings.original: I only carry the BEST stuff!
There isn't enough food to buy any! The trader gives a free molotov to
strings.translation: 你的这点食物什么都买不起! 作为安慰商人送给了
一个燃烧瓶, 只是为了促进僵尸的毁灭.

strings.original: robs the Blade Master of two of his best weapons. Both are powerful melee weapons in their own way.
strings.translation: 夺走了刀锋大师的两件最佳武器. 这两件武器都是威力强大的近战武器.

strings.original: The Blade Master manages to fight off
strings.translation: 刀锋高手使用他丰富的刀剑知识和批发武士刀成功击退了

strings.original: using his considerable sword knowledge and mall katana.
starts gnawing on one of the Blade Master's scabbards, in spite.
strings.translation: 开始咬刀锋大师的一个剑鞘.
你先别急. 这些冷冰冰的破烂有什么意思, 还不如一把火就能把僵尸都烧成灰.

strings.original: My life is a lie! I'm going to give up this sword stuff and start collecting flamethrowers.
strings.translation: 我过去都在干什么! 我要放弃这些破烂剑转去收集火焰喷射器!

strings.original: two of his best weapons. They are a sturdy machete and a
. The claymore is slow and hard to handle, but extremely powerful. It can sometimes chop 4 zombies at once!
strings.translation: 双刃大剑非常沉重, 难以驾驭, 但破坏力极强. 它可以一次砍碎4个僵尸!

strings.original: buys the type of sword a knight in the middle ages would use. This will make a great weapon! It can easily hit two zombies in one swing.
strings.translation: 购买了中世纪骑士使用的剑. 这将是很棒的武器! 一次挥剑就能轻松击中两只僵尸.

strings.original: buys a very strong yet light machete. It's sturdy enough to chop down trees with, so it won't break with 'road trip usage'.
strings.translation: 买了一把非常结实而轻巧的砍刀. 它足够结实, 可以用来砍树, 所以不会因为 【公路旅行】而损坏

strings.original: buys a katana of the type you'd get at a mall. It looks like it might break at any moment. What a rip off.
strings.translation: 买了一把商场里卖的那种武士刀. 看起来随时都可能坏掉. 真是坑爹.

strings.original: meets a man shuffling down the road. He's carrying many swords in scabbards or tied to his pack.
strings.translation: 遇到一个带着许多剑的人. 当他移动时, 身上的剑叮当作响.

strings.original: One day I'll make the finest zombie slicing sword ever seen! Though I have to figure out how to make swords first. I just found these lying around. I'll sell you one!
strings.translation: 总有一天, 我会制作出有史以来最好的砍僵尸剑! 但是首先我需要先弄清楚如何制作剑. 我可以卖给你一些我找到的剑!

strings.original: There isn't enough food to buy anything! As consolation the trader gives
strings.translation: 你的这点食物什么都买不起! 作为安慰商人送给了
强大的双刃大剑 - 35份食物

strings.original: robs the axe merchant, who simply stands there without responding at all.
strings.translation: 抢劫了斧头商人, 而斧头商人却站在那里没有任何反应.

strings.original: grabs the medieval axe but is too creeped out to steal a second thing.
strings.translation: 抢走了中世纪战斧, 却被吓了一身冷汗.

strings.original: The axe merchant moves way too fast for its appearance. In a flash, it is holding a huge medieval axe in one robed hand.
strings.translation: 斧头商人的动作太快了. 转眼间, 手中就多出了一把巨大的中世纪战斧.

strings.original: is far too terrified to continue the robbery attempt.
strings.translation: 被吓到了, 不敢继续抢劫.

strings.original: The axe merchant doesn't seem to react.
strings.translation: 斧头商人似乎没有反应.

strings.original: . This thing is really heavy and slow. It can often cleave 3 zombies at once! Give it to someone strong and fit.
strings.translation: . 这东西又重又慢. 但是它可以同时切碎3个僵尸! 把它送给强壮高体能的人使用吧.

strings.original: buys an axe-shaped guitar. This would make a stylish weapon.
strings.translation: 买了斧头形状的吉他. 用这种武器将会成为一种时尚.

strings.original: buys a fire axe. It's called this because it was what firefighters used to chop up zombies.
strings.translation: 买了消防斧. 之所以这么叫它, 是因为它是消防员用来砍僵尸的东西.

strings.original: buys a hatchet. It's the tiniest little axe.
strings.translation: 买了手斧. 这是最小的那种小斧头.

strings.original: meets a strange figure shuffling down the road. It's wearing a hooded robe and pulling a cart full of different types of axes.
strings.translation: 遇到了一个拖着脚走在路上的奇怪身影. 它穿着连帽长袍, 拉着一辆装满不同类型斧头的手推车.

strings.original: There isn't enough food to buy anything! As consolation the merchant gives
strings.translation: 你的这点食物什么都买不起! 作为安慰商人送给了

strings.original: a hockey stick, which I guess is axe shaped.
strings.translation: 一根冰球棒, 可能是因为球棒也是斧头形状的吧.

strings.original: buys a flamethrower. The traders don't say where they got it. Try not to set yourself on fire with this!
strings.translation: 买了火焰喷射器. 商人没有说明他是从哪里得到的. 你可别用这个把自己烧了!

strings.original: buys an automatic shotgun. NOW we're talking! You're set until you run out of shells for it.
strings.translation: 买了一把连发霰弹枪. 在子弹打光之前, 你可以一直不停射击. 这才像话嘛!

strings.original: buys an assault rifle. Whoever uses this needs a lot of shooting skill to handle it right!
strings.translation: 买了突击步枪. 这把枪需要使用者有很高的射击技能才能正确使用!

strings.original: buys an uzi. Great for spraying bullets EVERYWHERE. Even someone great with guns will have problems handling this.
strings.translation: 买了乌兹冲锋枪. 可以快速倾泻弹药. 但即使是枪法很好的人在使用时也会很难控制后坐力.

strings.original: buys a shotgun. What a classic choice! This weapon is good in the hands of nearly anyone.
strings.translation: 买了霰弹枪. 多么经典的选择! 这种武器几乎适合任何人使用.

strings.original: buys a cowboy rifle. Just like the cowboys used. Someone with good shooting skill could really make this work.
strings.translation: 买了牛仔步枪. 这是牛仔们过去用的经典型号. 不过只有射击技术高超的人才能发挥出这把枪的真正威力.

strings.original: buys a revolver. In the right hands, this could let someone using cheap bullets do a lot of zombie damage.
strings.translation: 买了左轮手枪. 如果掌握得当, 这把枪可以用廉价子弹就对僵尸照成大量伤害.

strings.original: buys a pistol. It was very cheap, but this is the same type one can find anywhere.
strings.translation: 买了手枪. 它很便宜, 但实际上手枪本来也到处都有.

strings.original: finds a large band of travelling survivors. They are trading firearms, though the selection seems like pretty common stuff.
strings.translation: 发现了一大群旅行的幸存者. 他们正在交易枪支, 不过他们卖的枪支似乎都很普通.

strings.original: demands to see the good stuff
Sadly, there isn't enough food left for trading.
strings.translation: 遗憾的是, 没有足够的食物来支付训练费.

strings.original: At the first glimmer of trouble, the trader opens his coat to reveal that he's covered in pipebombs. In a quick motion, he lights a fuse on one of them.
strings.translation: 在遇到麻烦的一瞬间, 商人打开外套, 露出自己身上挂满的土制炸弹. 接着, 他迅速点燃了其中一个的引线.

strings.original: is right next to him, and has just barely enough time to deeply regret the whole robbery thing.
strings.translation: 就站在商人旁边, 甚至来不及后悔这个鲁莽的决定.

strings.original: farts really loud at the pipebomb guy.
strings.translation: 对卖土制炸弹的家伙放了个响屁.
告诉卖土制炸弹的家伙

strings.original: NO! TAKE MY BOMBS! FREE SAMPLES!
strings.translation: 等等! 把我的炸弹都拿走吧! 免费样品!
25个土质炸弹! 这真的很多了!

strings.original: YOU COOL IT! YOU COOL IT!!
strings.translation: 别急 ? ! 你让我别急 ? ! 玛德和你爆了!

strings.original: The mood gets pretty tense with the guy selling explosives, so
strings.translation: 这个卖炸药的家伙让气氛变得很紧张, 所以

strings.original: an extra pipebomb in an extremely awkward attempt at either flirting or friendliness. It's hard to say for sure.
strings.translation: 一个额外的土制炸弹, 很难说是在调戏还是表达友好. 这很尴尬.

strings.original: finds a twitchy man selling homemade bombs. He's wearing a bulky coat with lumps bulging out from underneath.
strings.translation: 发现了一个卖自制炸弹的古怪男人. 他穿着一件臃肿的大衣, 大衣下面鼓鼓囊囊的.

strings.original: Sadly, there isn't enough food left for trading, though he does give away a free pipebomb!
strings.translation: 遗憾的是, 我们没有足够的食物能用来交易, 尽管他确实免费赠送了一个土制炸弹!

strings.original: robs the trader of some swords and shuriken, but smashes some perfectly usable animes in the process.
strings.translation: 抢走了商人的一些武士刀和手里剑, 但在此过程中砸坏了一些尚且完好的动画光盘.

strings.original: is foiled when the trader snaps the truck's armored shutters closed and then drives away.
strings.translation: 的计划泡汤了, 商人马上跑进他的车, 关上了车上的装甲百叶窗, 然后一脚油门扬长而去.
给你的一点小赠品, 可别和别人说这事儿*眨眼*
买了一颗巨大的风之手里剑.

strings.original: THIS IS THE OFFICIAL WINDSTAR USED IN THE LIVE-ACTION VERSION OF THE WINDSTAR ANIME!! EXCELLENT CHOICE!
strings.translation: 这是　急风传　动画真人版　中官方使用的风之手里剑! ! 绝佳的选择!

strings.original: buys an anime figurine. It seems really expensive...
strings.translation: 买了一个小手办. 看起来十分精致, 但肯定也很贵......

strings.original: I CAN TELL YOU HAVE EXQUISITE TASTES!
strings.translation: 我看得出来你很有品味!

strings.original: ENOUGH FOR A WHOLE GROUP! CUT THROUGH ANYTHING!
strings.translation: 足够一整个小队使用了! 我们能切碎一切!

strings.original: destroys some anime, as a protest against the very existence of anime. The anime trader gets the message.
strings.translation: 毁掉了一些动漫周边, 以此来抗议二刺螈的存在. 动漫商人很快听到了这个消息.
笑嘻嘻的和动漫商人说

strings.original:
COOL IT. 
	ALSO, ANIME ISN'T REAL!
strings.translation:
你先别急. 
	还有, 这些破塑料和保留文明有啥关系!

strings.original: There is no way that he could take this well.
strings.translation: 很显然他不可能接受这一点.

strings.original: NO! YOU'RE WRONG! STOP IT! NOooooooo!

strings.translation: 就我个人而言, 我更喜欢单发步枪. 自动武器消耗弹药太快了, 也没法一发打穿多个僵尸.

strings.translation: 买了霰弹枪. 多么经典的选择! 这种武器几乎适合任何人使用.

strings.translation: 买了手枪. 它很便宜, 但实际上手枪本来也到处都有.

strings.original: Things to do in Zombo Town:

The building to the right lets you view your stats and other information.
The center building lets you upgrade and unlock Perks and Traits. You can then use these to make powerful Starting or Custom Characters!
strings.translation:
右边的建筑可以让你查看你的统计数据和其他信息.
中心建筑可以让你解锁和升级天赋和特性. 然后你可以使用这些来自定义更加强大的起始角色!
去找找侏儒吧! 他有额外的解锁内容!

strings.original: Welcome to the Death Road to Canada!
strings.translation: 欢迎来到通往加拿大的死亡之路!
他许诺以你为原型做个

strings.original: if you get him to Canada.
strings.translation: 不过要在你把他活着带到加拿大后.

strings.original:
The normal, default game mode.
		Get your skis, pack a toque... we're going to CANADA!
		Most road recruits you find will be random, but sometimes you'll be more lucky.
strings.translation:
正常的默认游戏模式.
		带上你的滑雪板, 带上帽子......我们要去加拿大!
		你在路上发现的大多数可招募者都是随机的路人, 但有时你会遇到一些更特别的.

strings.original:
Most road recruits you meet are now familiar characters, instead of random!
		These are characters that you've created and saved. Make your friends and family, and they'll show up in the game!
strings.translation:
你遇到的大多数可招募者都是熟悉的角色, 而不是随机的!
		这些是你创建并保存的角色. 捏出你的朋友和家人, 然后他们就会出现在游戏中!

strings.original:
Most road recruits you meet are now special characters with unique abilities!
		This usually can make things a little easier.
		But not always.
strings.translation:
你遇到的大多数可招募者都是具有独特能力的特殊角色!
		这通常可以让游戏变得简单一点.
		但并非总是如此.

strings.original:
For impatient people that want a risky shortcut!
		It takes 9 driving days to get to Canada, rather than the default 15 days.
		Be careful, this means less days to prepare for the end!
strings.translation:
为那些想要赶快完成冒险的不耐烦的人设计!
		到达加拿大需要9天的车程, 而不是默认的15天.
		当心, 为最终决战做准备的时间也更少了!

strings.original:
A quick 9 driving day mode.
		Unlock by beating any of the normal difficulties. Death Road Normal Mode, Familiar Characters Mode, or Rare Characters Mode.
strings.translation:
9天短途旅行模式.
		解锁条件: 通关任意一次正常难度. 如　死亡之路　模式、　老友　模式或　怪人　模式.

strings.original:
For people that like to chill and take it easy.
		It takes 25 driving days to get to Canada, rather than the usual 15 days.
		Difficulty progression starts the same, but gets higher! At least you get more time to prepare.
strings.translation:
为那些喜欢放松的人设计.
		到加拿大需要25天的车程, 而不是通常的15天.
		难度在游戏开始时和普通模式相同, 但会越来越难! 但至少你有更多的时间做准备.

strings.original:
A longer 25 driving day mode.
		Unlock by beating any of the normal difficulties. Death Road Normal Mode, Familiar Characters Mode, or Rare Characters Mode.
strings.translation:
25天长途旅行模式.
		解锁条件: 通关任意一次正常难度. 如　死亡之路　模式、　老友　模式或　怪人　模式.

strings.original:
Start with up to 4 people, if you made Custom Characters!
		Made for 4 player co-op, or if you just want a full car at start.
		In exchange, about 15% more zombies will spawn.
strings.translation:
如果你制作了一些自定义角色, 在进入游戏后可以马上再招募几个同伴!
		专为四人合作打造, 或者如果你只是想在游戏一开始就拥有一辆满载小队成员的车.
		作为交换, 僵尸数量会提升大约15%.

strings.original:
30% more danger! 30% more excitement!
		About 30% more zombies.
		Bandits are more cruel.
strings.translation:
危险增加了30%! 但趣味也增加了30%!
		僵尸数量增加大约30%.
		强盗将会更残忍.

strings.original:
A tougher challenge! Gateway to harder modes!
		Unlock by beating any of the normal difficulties. Death Road Normal Mode, Familiar Characters Mode, or Rare Characters Mode.
strings.translation:
更艰巨的挑战! 通往其他更加困难模式的入口!
		解锁条件: 通关任意一次正常难度. 如　死亡之路　模式、　老友　模式或　怪人　模式.

strings.original:
Most recruits you meet are familiar characters!
		Make sure your custom characters are strong and work together well, because they will be facing 60% more the usual amount of zombies.
		Bandits are more cruel.
strings.translation:
你遇到的绝大多数可招募者都是自定义的角色!
		确保你的自定义角色强大, 搭配良好, 因为他们将面临1.6倍于普通模式的僵尸数量.
		强盗将会更残忍.

strings.original:
Very difficult challenge with custom characters!
		Unlock by beating both Deadlier Road Mode and Familiar Characters Mode.
strings.translation:
让你招募自定义角色来完成这个非常困难的挑战!
		解锁条件: 通关　超死亡之路　模式和　老友　模式.

strings.original:
Most recruits you meet are special characters!
		This is combined with the amount of zombies set to 60% more than usual. Can the unique characters you find survive gigantic walls of undead?
		Bandits are more cruel.
strings.translation:
你遇到的大多数新成员都是特殊角色!
		这也会给你带来1.6倍于普通模式的僵尸数量. 你招募的那些特殊角色能在僵尸大军中幸存下来吗?
		强盗将会更残忍.

strings.original:
Very difficult challenge with special characters!
		Unlock by beating both Deadlier Road Mode and Rare Characters Mode.
strings.translation:
让你招募特殊角色来完成这个非常困难的挑战!
		解锁条件: 通关　超死亡之路　模式和　怪人　模式.

strings.original:
A grueling challenge.
		It takes 30 driving days to get to Canada, rather than the usual 15 days. About a month of pain!
		Zombie amount starts off 50% higher than normal, and eventually goes to double. 
		Bandits are more cruel.
strings.translation:
一项艰巨的挑战.
		到加拿大需要30天的车程, 而不是通常的15天. 大约一个月的试炼!
		僵尸数量在开始时比普通模式高出50%, 到游戏后期将会高出100%.
		强盗更加残忍.

strings.original:
Extremely difficult challenge, with 30 driving days!
		Unlock by beating both Deadlier Road Mode and Long Winding Road Mode.
strings.translation:
极其困难的挑战, 需要驾驶30天!
		解锁条件: 通关　超死亡之路　模式和　漫漫长路　模式.

strings.original:
Kepa Expert Player Advanced Mode.
		Double the zombies, double the fun.
		Start with a Kepa. Do NOT let Kepa die. The ultimate challenge.
		Bandits are more cruel.
strings.translation:
为专业玩家设计的高级模式.
		双倍僵尸, 双倍快乐.
		与kepa一起开始旅程. 不能让kepa死掉. 这是终极挑战.
		强盗将会更残忍.

strings.original:
Abandon all hope ye who enter here.
		Unlock by beating all of the hard difficulties. Familiar Characters Extreme, Rare Characters Extreme, and Marathon Mode.
strings.translation:
来到这里的人必将抛弃一切希望.
		解锁条件: 通关所有困难模式以解锁. ｢老友　极限模式、｢怪人　极限模式和｢马拉松　模式.

strings.original:
Start with a car full of jerks, now with more zombies!
		About 100% more zombies will spawn, and the Final showdown will have twice as many zombies as normal! Double Deluxe!
		Bandits are more cruel.
strings.translation:
从一辆装满混蛋的车开始, 不过现在有更多的僵尸!
		僵尸数量比普通模式高出100%!
		最终决战的僵尸数量将是平时的两倍!
		强盗将会更残忍.

strings.original:
Way more zombies! Still four jerks.
		Unlock by beating Four Jerks Mode.
strings.translation:
更多的僵尸! 但还是从四个混蛋开始.
		解锁条件: 通关｢四个混蛋 」模式.

strings.original:
Canada is a myth perpetuated by the former government!
		America extends northward forever! Wake up sheeple!!!
		Travel forever-ish. See how far you can get.
		Bandits are more cruel.
strings.translation:
加拿大不过是个谎言!
		美国的领土向北无限延伸! 该醒醒了! 你这懒猪 ! ! !
		看不到尽头的旅行. 看看你能走多远.
		强盗将会更残忍.

strings.original:
An impossible challenge with no end in sight!
		Unlock by beating Marathon Mode.
strings.translation:
看起来没有尽头的不可能挑战!
		通关马拉松模式解锁.

strings.original:
Over Powered Party! Final showdown is twice as long!
		Get a special start that lets you pick any special characters you want and other goodies!
		Fight Triple the default zombie amount!! Bandits are more cruel. Wins here do not count towards streaks.
strings.translation:
超能小队! 最终决战围攻的时间是原来的两倍!
		游戏开始时进入特殊地图, 选择任何你想要的特殊角色或者隐藏角色!
		与3倍的僵尸战斗! ! 强盗会更残忍. 这个模式的胜利不计入连胜.

strings.original:
A for-fun mode that lets you start with whatever rare characters that you would like!
		Unlock by beating Familiar Characters Extreme and Rare Characters Extreme.
strings.translation:
一个有趣的模式, 让你以任何你想要的稀有角色开始游戏!
		解锁条件: 通关｢老友」极限模式和｢怪人」极限模式.

strings.original:
For anyone that wants to die FAST!
		It only takes 9 driving days to get to Canada!
		Triple the default zombie amount!!
		Bandits are more cruel.
strings.translation:
为任何想立刻暴毙的人设计!
		只需开车9天就可以到达加拿大!
		3倍僵尸数量! !
		强盗将会更残忍.

strings.original:
A quick 9 driving day mode, now with triple the zombies!
		Unlock by beating both Deadlier Road Mode and Short Trip to Heck Mode.
strings.translation:
一个快速的9天旅途模式, 但是有3倍的僵尸!
		解锁条件: 通关｢超死亡之路 」模式和｢短途旅行 」模式.

strings.original: evades any attempt to be picked up.
Stop that! I'll follow you, fine, just stop trying to pick me up!
strings.translation: 住手! 我会跟着你的, 好吧, 别再抓着我了!

strings.original: sees this as an opportunity to get a free broom, without even taking up an inventory slot!
strings.translation: 把这看作是一个免费获得扫帚的机会, 甚至不用占用车后备箱空间!
试图抓住这把扫帚. 但在

strings.original: found, but it suddenly starts talking!
strings.translation: 抓住它后, 它突然开始说话!

strings.original: HEY! Stop grabbing me, you DINGUS! I'm not a broom!
strings.translation: 嘿! 别抓我了, 你们这些混蛋! 我不是扫帚!

strings.original: This seems like an odd thing for a broom to say.
strings.translation: 扫帚会说话, 怎么看都很奇怪.

strings.original: Pretend like you never saw this broom

加拿大死亡之路---12年5月15号测试版

花了更多的时间去探索附近.

strings.original: This is everyone's fault but me!
strings.translation: 错的是这个世界, 不是我!
僵尸成精了! 成精了!

strings.original: Catch you on the flip side
I hope I don't turn into a skeleton
strings.translation: 我希望我的身体上还能留点肉

strings.original: Please don't throw my skeleton around
strings.translation: 请不要把我的骨架扔来扔去

strings.original: If only I threw more chairs...
strings.translation: 要是我扔了更多的椅子就好了......

strings.original: Wait, I think I dropped my gum!
strings.translation: 等等, 我嘴里的口香糖掉了!
等等! 我要重来一遍!

strings.original: Uh... I meant to do that!
This is aaaaall part of the plan, heh
strings.translation: 这就是计划的一部分, 呵呵

strings.original: Tell everyone my last words were cool!
strings.translation: 告诉大家我的遗言很酷!
骗子! 你们这些僵尸作弊了!

strings.original: Don't worry, I have a plan!
No one touch any of my stuff!
Bury me... with my food cans!
strings.translation: 把我和我的罐头埋在一块!

strings.original: Bury me with my beloved car keys!
strings.translation: 请用我心爱的车钥匙埋葬我!

strings.original: Bury me with a sweet headstone!
strings.translation: 请用一块上好的墓碑埋葬我!

strings.original: Oh well! Better luck next time.
strings.translation: 哦, 好吧! 下次好运.

strings.original: That was close! Oh wait, ow!
strings.translation: 太近了太近了! 嘿, 等等, 啊!
没问题! 我开始理解一切!

strings.original: Wait! I got something in my eye!
strings.translation: 等下! 我眼睛里进沙子了!

strings.original: I'm fine. I'll walk it off!
strings.translation: 我很好. 让我一走了之吧!

strings.original: Just got the wind knocked outta me.
strings.translation: 就让一阵风把我吹走吧.

strings.original: Heh, this is nothing! I've had worse!
strings.translation: 嘿, 这没什么! 我见过更糟的!

strings.original: I can still do this! One second!
strings.translation: 我还能继续! 再等一下!

strings.original: Excuse me... stop eating me please

strings.translation: 非常坏僵尸! 恨来自美国!

strings.original: Slow zombies aren't supposed to be dangerous!
strings.translation: 慢吞吞的僵尸本不该这么危险!

strings.original: Either these zombies go... or I do!

strings.translation: 我真希望这些只是番茄酱

strings.original: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle. I'm dead!

strings.translation: 那个僵尸在流口水, 真恶心

strings.original: No matter what... you gotta strut
strings.translation: 不管怎样......你得支棱起来
什么加拿大, 我看是假拿大!

strings.original: These zombies are sassing me back
I got bit, it's not a big deal!
strings.translation: 我被咬了, 但是没什么大不了的!
别说了, 你这个书呆子!
无论什么时候离开都很合理

strings.original: That's my purse, I don't know you
strings.translation: 那是我的手提包, 你别碰

strings.original: I can still make it! To Canada!
strings.translation: 我能做到的! 我要活着到达加拿大!

strings.original: I can still run... there's still hope!
I'm still feeling pretty optimistic, I think!
strings.translation: 我觉得我还是很乐观的!

strings.original: this was NOT a goat simulator reference
strings.translation: 我们可没去参考山羊模拟器

strings.original: YOU ARE DEAD... no wait I am dead
strings.translation: 你死了... 不等等好像是我死了

strings.original: Finally, I get to be 100% skeleton!
strings.translation: 终于, 我能变成纯粹的骷髅了!
真是谢了... 拜登... 噶啊
把我的腿... 和我埋在一起

strings.original: I'll make a map of Heaven next!
strings.translation: 下一步我将绘制天堂的地图!

strings.original: The skeleton was inside of me the whole time!
not here, and will be left behind.

strings.translation:
可能肌肉块过大了反而不好控制. 但是举起和投掷重型家具都很轻松!
		+ 初始装备 金属管

strings.original:
All that yoga really paid off!
		+ Start with some granola bars
strings.translation:
所有的瑜伽苦修真的得到了回报!
		+ 初始获得 一些燕麦棒

strings.original:
This person loves dogs, and tends to run into them!
		+ Angry dogs may become friendly
strings.translation:
爱狗人士, 而且会经常遇到狗狗!
		+ 可能将愤怒的狗会变得友好

strings.original:
Some people just have a really good sense of direction when driving!
		+ Get one extra location choice during Always Be Looting events!
strings.translation:
有些人在开车时就是有很好的方向感!
		+ 在｢搜刮不停歇 」事件中获得一个额外的地点选择!

strings.original:
Was top dog before a tragic mishap in the ring!
		+ Pick up downed zombies, then throw or slam them!
		- Large penalty to maximum shooting skill.
strings.translation:
曾经的顶级选手, 直到他的膝盖在摔跤场上｢中了一箭 」!
		+ 可以举起倒下的僵尸, 然后扔出或摔碎他们!
		- 大大降低射击属性上限.

strings.original:
Looks unassuming, but can exceed others with training!
		+ Every 2nd increase in strength or fitness also increases the maximum for that stat by 1!
strings.translation:
看起来不起眼, 但经过训练可以超越其他人!
		+ 随机获得1点力量或体能. 并提升1点对应能力上限!

strings.original:
Good salesmanship still has its own niche!
		+ Gets 1-8 extra food when selling to a weapons buyer, depending on original price.
		+ No morale penalty when paying bandit tolls with food!
strings.translation:
我有特殊的销售技巧!
		+ 根据原价, 出售武器时可获得1-8份额外食物.
		+ 用食物支付强盗通行费时没有士气惩罚!

strings.original:
Hiking experience helps avoid forest terrors!
		+ Removes a penalty event from the 1st walking day, every time you lose the car!
strings.translation:
有丰富的徒步旅行经验来避免森林中的恐怖!
		+ 当你的汽车报废后, 跳过步行第一天的惩罚事件.

strings.original:
Stands out from the crowd, with a signature weapon!
		+ Starts with a special weapon, depending on trait!
		- Can not drop this weapon, even in death.
strings.translation:
拥有与众不同的专属武器!
		+ 初始装备 根据角色特性改变的专属武器!
		- 即使死亡也无法掉落这把武器.

strings.original: A natural at shooting! Just needs more training and maybe even a gun and ammo!
strings.translation: 非常有射击天分! 但是需要更多的训练, 可能还需要一把枪和弹药!

strings.original:
Definitely too swole! REFUSES to do cardio!
		+ Starts at full strength!
		+ May train strength 6 times over the maximum!!!
strings.translation:
强壮到臃肿! 拒绝一切有氧运动!
		+ 初始拥有 满级力量 !
		+ 可以在最大值上再增加6点力量 ! ! !

strings.original:
Keeps going through sheer willpower!
		+ Protects against fatal hits if morale is over :(
		- Will still die to some instant-kill events.
strings.translation:
保持决心, 越过绝境!
		+ 消耗士气来抵御致命伤害 : (
		- 仍然会死于某些秒杀事件.

strings.original:
Archery ended up being a useful hobby!
		+ Start with a silent bow, 30 arrows, 2 points in strength!
		- Can not drop this bow, even in death.
strings.translation:
射箭终会成为一种有用的爱好!
		+ 初始装备带有30个箭的弓 .
		+ 获得2点力量!
		- 即使死亡也无法掉落这把弓.

strings.original:
Zombies are extremely flammable!
		+ Start with a blowtorch, and protection against fire!
		- Can't drop this blowtorch, even in death.
strings.translation:
僵尸是极度易燃的!
		+ 初始装备 喷灯 , 同时能够免疫火焰!
		- 即使死亡也无法掉落这个喷灯.

strings.original:
This person hits hard and strong. Better watch out!
		+ Gain a
strings.translation:
这人击打东西的威力特别大. 最好看着点!
		+ 有

strings.original:
% chance to instantly kill any zombie with melee!
		+ 1 strength point
		- Doesn't work with default punch or when exhausted
strings.translation:
% 的几率用近战武器秒杀僵尸!
		+ 获得1点力量点
		- 在空手或是精疲力竭时无法秒杀

strings.original:
Always here to help in a pickle!
		- Run speed penalty
		+
strings.translation:
总是及时的前来帮助!
		- 行走速度变慢
		+

strings.original:
Master of none, but still pretty good at things generally.
		+
strings.translation:
并不专精, 但是什么都会一点.
		+

strings.original:
A combination of high perception and extreme pessimism lets someone brace for the worst!
		+ May identify traits in new recruits
		+ Always on the lookout for danger
		- Can be a real grumpus
strings.translation:
高感知和极度悲观的结合使他对一切最坏的情况做好了准备!
		+ 可能会识别新招募人员的特质
		+ 总是能够识破危险
		- 脾气真的非常暴躁

strings.original:
A great outlook on life combined with not being very perceptive allows for some magical feats of denial!
		+ May ignore despair
		- Bad rolls for perception and wits
strings.translation:
超凡脱俗的人生观加上迟钝的感知能力使他经常做出一些神奇行为来应对事件!
		+ 可能会忘掉绝望
		- 有感知和智慧上的缺陷

strings.original:
From perception of others, a good attitude, and pure charisma, there's something about this person that opens doors!
		+ Charms way into free stuff or out of bad situations
		- Can't charm way out of everything
strings.translation:
能够理解他人, 有良好的态度和纯粹的个人魅力. 其身上的某种东西可以让其他人敞开心扉!
		+ 用个人魅力获得免费的资源或摆脱不利的局面
		- 魅力无法解决一切

strings.original:
This person thinks they're soooooo cool. But they're not! They're just annoying!
		+ Tell people to 'Cool it'
		- Anger pretty much everybody
strings.translation:
这种人觉得没人配比他更急. 但实际上他一点也不急! 他只是想阴阳怪气!
		+ 可以和其他人说 '你先别急 '
		- ｢几乎」会激怒所有人

strings.original:
Being untrustworthy can be an asset in the post-apocalypse.
		+ Rip others off
		- Rip the group off
		- Ticking time bomb
strings.translation:
在世界末日之后, 言而无信也是一种财富.
		+ 欺骗他人
		- 可能会背叛小队成员
		- 不稳定因素

strings.original:
This person... has a mysterious past......
		+ 3 points given to fight skills at random
		- Randomized and extreme personality!
strings.translation:
这个人...有着神秘的过去......
		+ 增加3点随机的战斗属性
		- 随机并且极端的性格!

strings.original:
Has a variety of useful skills, but is kind of boring.
		+ 3 points given to fight skills at random
		+ 3 points given to support skills at random
		- Boring personality
strings.translation:
拥有各种实用的技能, 但是有些无趣.
		+ 增加3点随机的战斗属性
		+ 增加3点随机的辅助属性
		- 平淡的性格

strings.original:
Good start on zombie thwacking skills, with a nondescript personality.
		+ 2 points more strength!
		+ 2 points more fitness!
		- Boring personality
strings.translation:
拥有良好的对抗僵尸属性, 但在性格上没什么特别的.
		+ 获得2点力量属性!
		+ 获得2点体能属性!
		- 平淡的性格

strings.original:
Someone's got a bad temper! The aggression can come in handy.
		+ 1 extra point in strength
		- Bad temper due to low composure
		+ Temper can sometimes be good
		+ Gain a 5% chance to instantly kill any zombie with melee!!!
strings.translation:
有些家伙脾气不好! 这种侵略式性格有时能发挥很大作用.
		+ 获得1点力量!
		- 情绪低落会导致脾气暴躁
		+ 坏脾气有时很有用
		+ 拥有 5% 的概率使用近战武器秒杀僵尸!!!

strings.original:
Calm and collected. Useful when shooting into a horde!
		+ Very calm due to high composure
		+ 1 extra point in shooting
strings.translation:
沉着冷静, 在向着尸群开火时会很有用!
		+ 高度镇定, 非常冷静
		+ 获得1点射击!

strings.original:
Always thinking of others! Somehow not zombie food yet.
		+ 2 points more medical! Great Attitude
		+ Can go one over maximum for medical skill!!
		- May be an act
strings.translation:
总是为别人着想! 不知为何还没成为僵尸的食物.
		+ 获得2点医疗属性! 极佳的态度
		+ 增加1点医疗属性上限! !
		- 可能只不过是装出来的罢了

strings.original:
Comfortable with machinery, such as cars.
		+ 2 points more mechanical!  Great wits checks!
		+ Can go one over maximum for mechanical skill!!
		- May need more practice to repair car
strings.translation:
熟悉机械设备, 比如汽车.
		+ 获得2点机械属性! 极佳的智力!
		+ 增加1点机械属性上限! !
		- 可能需要更多练习才能真的修好一辆车

strings.original:
Kind of a fragile sort. But really good at fleeing!
		+ Run speed bonus!
		- Takes one less hit than normal
		- Bad attitude
strings.translation:
有一颗玻璃心, 但是真的很擅长逃跑
		+ 移动速度获得提升!
		- 降低1点生命上限
		- 态度很差

strings.original:
Really tough! The muscle! Not a long term planner.
		+ Resist 1 damage once per event, even from bandits!
		- Bad wits rolls
strings.translation:
很皮实! 肌肉发达! 讨厌长期规划.
		+ 提升1点生命上限
		- 智力低下

strings.original:
Destroy all zombies! Never retreat! Oh no, I got bit!
		+ 4 points to strength, fitness, and shooting!!
		+ Can go one over the maximum for the above stats!!!
		- Super low personality stats! Dies in one bite!!
strings.translation:
砸烂所有僵尸! 寸步不让! 噢不, 我被咬了!
		+ 获得4点体能, 力量以及射击!!
		+ 战斗技能可以超过最大值!!!
		- 性格极其恶劣! 只要被咬中一次就会死亡!!

strings.original:
Retains old values before world went crazy. This is good and bad.
		+ Super high loyalty and personality stats!
		+ 1 point to medical and mechanical skills!!
		- Permanent and significant morale penalty!!
strings.translation:
在疯狂的世界中保留了以前的价值观, 这既是好事也是坏事.
		+ 极其优秀的性格和超高的忠诚!
		+ 获得1点机械属性! 1点医疗属性! !
		- 士气上限大幅度降低! !

strings.original:
Sleeps anytime, anywhere. #1 best at sleeping!
		+ Superhuman sleeping! Needs very little sleep.
		+ Never gets the TIRED status, ever.
strings.translation:
在哪里, 在何时, 都能睡. 睡眠界领头者!
		+ 睡觉超人! 只需要很少的睡眠.
		+ 永远不会进入疲惫状态.

strings.original:
Really appreciates old canned food!
		+ Eating a full meal restores 1 extra morale to you and your team! Gets an extra point of max health!
		- Eats 3 food instead of 2. Running low on food decreases morale faster!
strings.translation:
什么都想尝尝. 能吃东西简直是福报!
		+ 吃一顿饱饭可以额外恢复1点士气!
		+ 提升1点最大生命
		- 每顿饭会消耗3份食物. 食物不足会更快地降低士气!

strings.original:
Blessed with an interesting life!
		+ Much greater chance of finding a weird building or character in city looting events! Normal chance: 10%  With trait: 50%
		+ Doubles the chance to find Rare Trader Camps!
strings.translation:
愿你的生活丰富有趣!
		+ 在搜刮城市建筑时发现更多的探索事件和特殊建筑!
		一般情况: 10%   有此特质: 50%
		+ 找到稀有交易营地的概率翻倍!

strings.original:
Carry less so you can run a little faster!
		+ Run speed bonus!
		+ 1 point more in fitness!
		- Can only carry two weapons at a time!
strings.translation:
带少点, 这样就能跑得更快!
		+ 获得移动速度提升!
		+ 获得1点体能!
		- 一次只能携带两件武器!

strings.original:
I'll protect you!...sometimes.
		+ Prevents teammate death in text events once per game.
		+ Starts with 6 loyalty!
		+ Protects nearby teammates in missions for up to 3s. Charge with zomb kills!
strings.translation:
我会牢牢保护你. 嗯, 就一次.
		+ 可以在事件中拯救队友免于死亡!
		- 整局只能使用一次!
		+ 拥有最高的忠诚!

strings.original:
Eats much less than normal! Takes tiny bites!
		+ A full meal only requires 1 food!!
		- Gets a 2 point penalty to maximum strength!
		- Gets a 1 point penalty to maximum fitness.
strings.translation:
吃得比正常人少得多! 就吃一小口!
		+ 每顿饭只消耗1份食物! !
		- 降低2点力量上限
		- 降低1点体力上限

strings.original:
This is just like my zombie animes!
		+ Weapon is replaced with an overpowered Strong Katana.
		- Katana can't be dropped, even on death.
		- WARNING: Avoid getting full morale! BEWARE ANIME!
strings.translation:
这简直就像我最爱的僵尸动漫!
		+ 初始强制装备　真武士刀.
		- 这把武士刀即使死亡也无法掉落.
		- 警告: 避免此角色士气高涨! 小心二刺螈!

strings.original:
A little too fixated on one method of zombie splatting.
		+ 2 points to strength, fitness, and shooting
		+ Can go one over the maximum for the above stats!!
		- Can only carry ONE WEAPON at a time!!
strings.translation:
有亿点执着于让僵尸四分五裂.
		+ 获得2点体能, 力量以及射击! !
		+ 获得1点体能, 力量以及射击额外上限! !
		- 一次只能携带一件武器! !

strings.original:
If a zombie falls down, you can pick it up!
		+ Throw or slam carried zombies!
		- Boring personality
strings.translation:
如果僵尸倒下了, 你可以把它举起来!
		+扔出或摔碎举起的僵尸!
		- 平淡的性格

strings.original:
Literally too spicy to die.
		+ Resurrects self on death, to full health!!
		+ Immune to fire 
		+ Has hot sauce; creates rings of fire on use!
		- Only the sauce remains after revival
strings.translation:
凤凰涅槃浴火重生, 喜欢像翅膀一样拍打手臂
		+ 死后复活, 获得完全生命值! !
		+ 免疫火焰! 火中做自己!
		- 复活后失去全部特质!

strings.original:
Always destined for great things! Never bothered to work for it.
		+ 2 points to medical, mechanical, shooting! Can go 1 over the maximum for these stats also!  
		- Takes 1 less hit than normal
		- 2 point penalty to max morale
strings.translation:
总是想着要做大事! 但是却从来没有付诸行动.
		+ 射击和辅助技能获得1点额外上限!
		- 降低1点生命上限
		- 士气上限大幅度降低! !

strings.original:
Starts low, but learns new skills fast!
		+ Gets double the amount of shooting, mechanical, and medical skill!
		- Each growth bonus stops after its skill gets to 4 points
strings.translation:
一开始不怎么样, 但学习技能更快!
		+ 获得双倍的射击、机械和医疗属性提升!
		- 当属性达到4级后, 将不再获得此属性的双倍提升效果

strings.original:
This person's got a bad mood! Well, sometimes.
		+ Personality is randomized upon each new day!
		+ 2 randomly chosen stats in fight & support skills may be trained 1 over the maximum!
strings.translation:
这人性格不好! 额, 有时是这样的.
		+ 每一天性格都会随机重置!
		+ 在战斗与辅助技能中随机2种分别获得1点上限!

strings.original:
When things are desparate, this person goes all out!
		+ Gain a bonus to strength, fitness, shooting, and run speed when at 1 health!
		- Bonuses removed when healed above 1 health
strings.translation:
当一切变得绝望, 这个人会爆发出极大的潜力!
		+ 在仅剩1点血量时会临时获得获得额外的1点力量,体能,射击, 以及移动速度!
		- 血量回复到一点以上的时候会失去这些临时的提升
之前装备的天赋已自动强化!
